CONFIRMED AND REPEATABLE: Young Life REGION sites (not area sites) on their own domains run WordPress with per-person staff pages at <regionsite>/regional-staff/<first>-<last>/ — e.g. westerngreatlakesyl.com/regional-staff/matt-dehoog/, /erika-castillo/, /beth-price-3/, /missy-johnson/. The roster index is /regional-staff/. Same sites also publish named 'new area director' announcement posts whose slugs key on the AREA, not the person (/rockford-young-life-welcomes-director/), and per-person WordPress tag archives at /tag/<first>-<last>/. Young Life has ~50 US regions; this shape should be tried on each region's own domain.

younglife.org area SUBDOMAINS (<area>.younglife.org) are a uniform national CMS: /about/, /leadership/, /find-us/, /donate/, /contact/. Rosters only — NO per-person page path exists on this CMS. Confirmed across losangeles, philadelphia, northerncolorado, yorkcounty, northeastflorida, lehighvalley, portlandeast, manateecounty, frederick, chattanooga, charlottesville, greatermaplevalley, jacksonville, eo (Ottawa), wvu. Titles carry the YL area code (AF54, AG487, WV75, CO27, SC28, PA25). These are worth a FETCH pass for roster names, not a search pass.

westerngreatlakesyl.com — Western Great Lakes Region (MI/IN). BEST HIT of this slice. Per-person /regional-staff/<name>/ pages plus named area-director announcement posts. Not exhausted; more names remain behind /regional-staff/ and /category/area-directors/ and /category/wglr-staff/.
ylwesttexasregion.wordpress.com — West Texas Region. Flat /staff-directory/ page, no per-person URLs. Names reachable only by fetching the directory page.
rayl.org — Richardson Area Young Life (TX), independent area domain. Has /staff, /staff-contact-berkner, /wyldlifecontact, /capernaum, /get-involved. No names surfaced in search; worth a fetch pass.
ylacalifornia.com/staff/ — Young Life Adventures California. Staff page publishes FIRST NAMES ONLY (James, Courtney) per the search surface — not emittable.
younglifeone.org/the-team/ — Young Life ONE, independent domain, team page. Surfaced first names only (Rachel, Heather). Fetch pass needed.
middletonyounglife.com/become-a-financial-parter-1 — NW Treasure Valley & Middleton YL. Area-level giving page, not per-person.

giving.younglife.org (Salesforce portal), foundation.younglife.org, fundinghelp.younglife.org, catholicengagement.younglife.org/give/, africa.younglife.org/donate/sponsorships/ — all AREA- or FUND-level giving. No per-person giving slug exists on any Young Life giving surface I could reach. Staff sponsorship is sold as a $12,000/yr unit, not as a named person's page.
staff.younglife.org / younglife.sharepoint.com — login-walled staff intranet. Dead for enumeration.
jobs.younglife.org and younglife.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com — job postings only; vacant roles, not people.

mea.younglife.org/about/our-staff/ (Middle EurAsia) and dgl.younglife.org/our-team/ — international/DGL staff pages. MEA surfaced first-names-only for workers in sensitive regions; treated as out of scope for this slice and not emitted.

Young Life College / WyldLife / Capernaum / YoungLives do NOT run separate staff sites. They appear as ROLE TITLES on ordinary area rosters ('Capernaum Coordinator', 'YoungLives Coordinator', 'WyldLife Staff'), e.g. yorkcounty.younglife.org/about/ and portlandeast.younglife.org. capernaum.younglife.org and ylcollege.younglife.org are national program sites with no staff surface. Do not spend a future wave hunting them as separate orgs.
